title: quassia sanguinea
intro: Quassia sanguinea, commonly known as the Blood Quassia or Sanguinea, is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and its ability to support digestive health by reducing symptoms of bloating and gas. The therapeutic actions of Quassia sanguinea include its use as a bitter tonic to stimulate digestion and its application in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever and cough. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include quassin, a lignan glycoside with potential antimalarial and antiparasitic activities, and other compounds such as alkaloids and phenolic acids.
